observations: body L4, L25-L26: heavy brackets close the addition begun on p. 225 (L4) and open and close that of L25-L26.

body L1, L5, L13, L17, L28-L29: the dashes of «Al–Battānī», «al–Ma’mūn», «120–121», «’l–qarnayn» and «ar–Raqqah» are long dashes (4.9 to 5.5 pt); that of «al–Battānī» in the small type of the table measures 4.1 pt.

body L4, L14-L15, L24, L27: the dashes before «Schiaparelli» and «In hoc» and after «e)», «f)» and «g)» in the heads measure 9.6 to 10.4 pt and are transcribed as dashes; that of «9–21» in the head is a long dash.
body L5: «khalifae» is printed without the long mark of «khalīfae» on pp. 207, 211 and 214, as on p. 221; so is «khalifa» in the second note.
body L9-L13: the table is boxed with double rules; its rows are set in a smaller type than the text.

body L10: Ptolemy's daily motions (13;10,34,58,33,30,30° in longitude, 13;3,53,56,17,51,59° in anomaly, 13;13,45,39,48,56,37° in latitude) give in 365 days 129;22,46,13,50,32,30° and 88;43,7,28,41,13,55°, as printed, and 148;42,47,12,44,25,5° in latitude; latitude less longitude, the motion of the node (note 1), is 19;20,0,58,53,52,35°: the print has 25 in the sixths.

body L13: al-Battānī's tables give in a Roman year of 365 days 129° 23′ 8″, 88° 43′ 7″ and, for the node, 19° 19′ 38″ (Part II, p. 73); his 134° 1′ 57″ of the node in 100 years (Part II, p. 77) is the difference of the 81° 59′ 43″ and 307° 57′ 46″ of p. 225 and gives the same 19° 19′ 38″. The printed 19° 20′ 37″ is 59″ more.
body L16, L18-L21: 254 2/3, 64 1/6, 166 and 1070 Earth radii are the numbers of p. 61 and pp. 120–121.
body L28: 8 Āb of the year 1202 of the era of Dhū ’l-qarnayn, which began on 1 October 890, is 8 August 891.
notes_left L2-L3, notes_right L4-L5: the dashes of «222-25» and «226-237» are hyphens (3.2 and 3.5 pt); those of «N–W» and «ar–Rashīd» are long dashes of the notes (4.3 and 4.2 pt).
notes_right L1: «1835»: the addenda (Part I, p. LXXIV) correct it to 1836.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
